_about: Rendered unit banners (render kit: _work/art/kit). One entry per rendered unit; alt describes the rendered picture. apply_banners.py only swaps a unit whose img/banners/<id>-1600.webp exists. Leave alt out to reuse the old SVG's aria-label. pencil_alt describes the pencil drawing (apply_banners.py --style pencil; drawings made by _work/art/pencil/pencil.py).

bib-u1.alt: A garden valley at first light: a great tree beside a river that winds away between green hills, a soft rainbow in the sky and a wooden boat resting on a hilltop
bib-u1.pencil_alt: A pencil drawing of a great old book lying open on a wooden lectern, with a rolled double scroll on one side and a clay oil lamp with a small flame on the other

sci-u1.alt: A playground at golden hour: a swing set with one swing in mid-arc, a red slide, a red wagon on the grass and a ball on a small hill
sci-u1.pencil_alt: A pencil drawing of a toy wagon with its pull handle raised, a ball beside it and a horseshoe magnet holding two paper clips

mth-u1.alt: A yellow school bus at the curb outside a brick school on a bright morning, with a hundred-chart poster in one window and ten-frame squares painted on the sidewalk
mth-u1.pencil_alt: A pencil drawing of a wooden counting frame with beads slid across its rods, beside three number blocks carved 1, 2 and 3

ush-u1.alt: The great mound of Cahokia at dusk on the Mississippi floodplain, with a thatched house on top, a timber palisade and a dugout canoe on the river
ush-u1.pencil_alt: A pencil drawing of Cahokia's great terraced earthen mound, with a long stair up its face, a thatched temple on the summit, houses at its foot and a timber palisade behind

ela-u1.alt: Wooden alphabet blocks stacked on a rug beside an open picture book, under a warm lamp, with sunlight from a window
ela-u1.pencil_alt: A pencil drawing of three wooden alphabet blocks carved A, B and C with a pencil resting on top, beside an open picture book showing a letter A and an apple

qur-u1.alt: An open book on a folding wooden stand beneath a hanging brass lamp, against a wall of blue and gold star tiles
qur-u1.pencil_alt: A pencil drawing of an open book on a carved wooden rahle, the X-shaped folding book stand, in front of a wall of eight-point star tiles

ssc-u1.pencil_alt: A pencil drawing of a small wooden schoolhouse with a bell tower on its roof, an apple and two stacked books beside it

chn-u1.pencil_alt: A pencil drawing of an unrolled book of bamboo slips tied with cord, its end still rolled up, beside a round pot holding writing brushes and a flat ink stone with an ink stick

ela-u2.pencil_alt: A pencil drawing of an open book resting on a slanted wooden reading stand, with three word cards fanned out on the table and a pencil beside them

qur-u3.pencil_alt: A pencil drawing of a string of prayer beads with a tassel, lying on a folded prayer mat patterned with a border and an arch
